versions.changelog:
Initial release of execution-window-optimizer.

- Provides real-time identification of optimal execution windows based on market volatility and liquidity.
- Integrates with APEX Runner’s live trading system across Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid.
- Access via x402-authenticated GET request; only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet required.
- Clear pricing with automatic early adopter discounts.
- Example response and usage included for easy onboarding.
